title: FACET: backbone torsion angle prediction from NMR chemical shifts
description:
FACET predicts protein backbone phi/psi torsion angles, secondary structure, chi1 rotamers and per-residue Ramachandran basin populations from backbone NMR chemical shifts (H, HA, N, CA, CB, C). A 1.29M-parameter local-biased transformer produces per-residue embeddings; phi/psi are inferred by kNN + DBSCAN retrieval over a 220K-residue reference index, with a mask-aware fallback for residues with missing shifts. Outputs include XPLOR/CNS, CYANA and NEF dihedral restraints. On a leak-safe 745-protein benchmark (53,876 residues predicted by both methods, corrected ground truth) FACET reaches an 11.03° median error versus 11.51° for TALOS-N (−0.48°, 95% CI [−0.64, −0.37]).

Model weights and reference data are archived separately at https://huggingface.co/SiXa18/facet-weights.
